question:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom:

'Cast pearls before swine'

options.text: Sell things at very high prices

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom "**Cast pearls before swine**" means giving something valuable or precious to someone who does not appreciate its worth.
 
• It originates from the Bible and highlights the futility of offering valuable things to those who cannot understand or value them.
